findings.claim: In concatenatedRSToASN1DER, lines 114-115 call ASN1Encoder.create().write(rBigInteger) and ASN1Encoder.create().write(sBigInteger) and discard the results. The return statement at lines 117-121 repeats the encoding with new encoders, so lines 114-115 are dead code.

verifier.reason: In AuthzClientCryptoProvider.java:114-115, ASN1Encoder.create().write(rBigInteger) and ASN1Encoder.create().write(sBigInteger) write only to newly allocated private ByteArrayOutputStream instances (ASN1Encoder.java:38-49) and discard the results. AuthzClientCryptoProvider.java:117-121 then repeats both calls on new encoders inside writeDerSeq, so lines 114-115 are dead code.

findings.claim: CryptoIntegration.detectProvider() no longer throws the fail-fast 'Multiple crypto providers loaded' IllegalStateException; it picks the highest order() instead. The Default, Elytron and FIPS1402 providers all return 200, so a tie is decided by ServiceLoader/classpath order. For example, a FIPS deployment with a stray crypto-default jar can run on non-FIPS BouncyCastle without failing.

verifier.reason: In common/src/main/java/org/keycloak/common/crypto/CryptoIntegration.java:55-73, detectProvider() sorts loaded providers by order() descending, logs extras at debug level, and returns foundProviders.get(0) without throwing on multiple providers or equal-order ties. DefaultCryptoProvider (crypto/default/src/main/java/org/keycloak/crypto/def/DefaultCryptoProvider.java:82-85), WildFlyElytronProvider (crypto/elytron/src/main/java/org/keycloak/crypto/elytron/WildFlyElytronProvider.java:75-78), and FIPS1402Provider (crypto/fips1402/src/main/java/org/keycloak/crypto/fips/FIPS1402Provider.java:113-116) all return 200, so ties fall back to ServiceLoader/classpath order and auto-detecting deployments with a stray crypto-default jar can silently select non-FIPS BouncyCastle.

findings.claim: concatenatedRSToASN1DER() assumes signature.length == signLength without validating it. A malformed signature can throw ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException instead of IOException.

verifier.reason: In crypto/default/src/main/java/org/keycloak/crypto/def/BCECDSACryptoProvider.java:28-35 (as well as crypto/fips1402/src/main/java/org/keycloak/crypto/fips/BCFIPSECDSACryptoProvider.java:28-35 and crypto/elytron/src/main/java/org/keycloak/crypto/elytron/ElytronECDSACryptoProvider.java:37-44), concatenatedRSToASN1DER() copies len = signLength / 2 bytes twice via System.arraycopy without checking signature.length, so a shorter malformed signature throws ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException instead of the declared IOException. Callers such as core/src/main/java/org/keycloak/crypto/ECDSASignatureVerifierContext.java:27-35 catch Exception and wrap it in VerificationException, and the underlying ECDSACryptoProvider implementations are pre-existing code.
